title: Issue 2449 generated-target semantic conformance

intent.outcome: Require current complete semantic-conformance proof for every generated target advertised as runnable, and make failed, missing, stale, or unsupported proof block support-bearing promotion for the exact packed artifacts.
non_goals: Do not redesign the operation contracts or generated-command architecture beyond changes required by reproduced conformance gaps.
Do not duplicate the authoritative conformance registry in TypeScript-only fixtures, CI prose, or release metadata.
Do not absorb the broader release-composition, runtime-matrix, distribution, license, or security outcomes owned by sibling issues under #2448.

parent.contribution: Supply the runnable-target semantic-conformance receipt and fail-closed promotion input required by the #2448 release lane.
parent.closure_boundary: Issue #2449 only; #2448 remains open until all release-critical receipts compose into the support-bearing promotion decision.

effects: Changes to canonical command-package contracts or generators may refresh checked-in Python and TypeScript generated packages.
PR validation gains a bounded representative semantic-conformance shard; support-bearing release validation gains complete exact-packed-artifact conformance.
Runnable or publishable status fails closed when the required conformance receipt is missing, stale, mismatched, failed, or unsupported.

next_action: Reproduce and classify the current TypeScript semantic-conformance failures with the complete authoritative registry, then repair the narrowest canonical contract/generator boundary before wiring bounded PR and exact-packed-artifact release proof.

claims: The full authoritative TypeScript semantic-conformance registry passes with zero adapter failures on the declared minimum and current Node majors.

Every runnable generated target has current proof bound to the exact packed artifact and runtime, and support-bearing promotion fails closed for missing, stale, mismatched, failed, or unsupported receipts.
PR CI exercises a bounded representative semantic shard while release proof exercises the complete registry without creating a second conformance authority.
requirements: uv run --active python scripts/run_agentic_workspace.py proof --target . --changed <paths> --format json
Inspect packed npm tarball conformance and the promotion refusal fixture for one intentionally invalid or stale receipt.

continuation.residual_intent: After #2449 closes, continue the remaining Phase 0 release-critical slices and compose their receipts under #2448.

execution_bounds.allowed paths: Only the scope.owned paths above and regenerated outputs attributable to an edited canonical source.
execution_bounds.max changed files: Keep the implementation to the smallest conformance, generator, focused-test, CI, release-proof, and Planning surfaces that satisfy #2449; generated refreshes may expand the mechanical file count.
execution_bounds.required validation commands: Run the complete Node-backed conformance registry, focused conformance/proof/promotion tests, generated-package freshness, and AW changed-path proof.
execution_bounds.ask-before-refactor threshold: Stop before redesigning operation semantics, replacing the command-package IR, widening the supported runtime matrix, or creating a new release framework.
execution_bounds.stop before touching: Do not hand-edit generated outputs, publish packages, change repository protection, choose distribution names/licenses, or weaken runnable claims to hide a failing supported target.

validation_commands: uv run --active python scripts/run_agentic_workspace.py proof --target . --changed <paths> --format json
completion_criteria: The complete semantic registry passes with zero adapter failures for the declared minimum and current Node majors.
Invalid-option, unsupported-command, mutation-refusal, dry-run, output-shape, required-field, and exit-code cases remain sourced from the authoritative conformance contract.
A bounded PR shard catches representative drift and release proof runs the complete registry against the exact packed npm artifacts.
Runnable/publishable status and #2448 promotion reject missing, stale, mismatched, failed, or unsupported conformance receipts.
The conformance subject fingerprint and receipt identity are available to the release manifest/promotion result without duplicating authority.
Focused tests, generated freshness, changed-path proof, and the #2449 closeout/intent review pass.

stop_conditions.stop when: A generated output would need a hand edit that cannot be reproduced from a canonical source.
stop_conditions.escalate when boundary reached: The reproduced failures require changing operation semantics rather than repairing a projection, adapter, generator, or conformance fixture.
stop_conditions.escalate on scope drift: The fix would widen the declared Node/runtime support matrix or change distribution, license, repository-protection, or security policy owned by sibling #2448 issues.
stop_conditions.escalate on proof failure: Packed-artifact proof cannot identify an exact artifact fingerprint or current authoritative receipt without first implementing a separate #2448 promotion compiler.
